DIFC - HCT Demo Day | Emirates NBD

Future Leaders Outreach Program

Experience Innovation. Empower Emirati Talent.

Hosted in partnership with the Higher Colleges of Technology (HCT), this event brings together visionary investors, industry leaders, and innovators from across the DIFC community to witness the next generation of Emirati entrepreneurial talent.

Six promising student teams will present their groundbreaking business solutions — each reflecting the spirit of creativity, technology, and impact that drives the UAE’s innovation ecosystem.
